title: 20-Year Treasury Bond auction (reopening)
source: TSY: treasury.gov tentative auction schedule PDF, text layer read directly 2026-09-01 — row reads verbatim '20-Year BOND R / Announcement Thursday, September 10, 2026 / Auction Tuesday, September 15, 2026 / Settlement Friday, September 18, 2026', 1:00pm ET
notes: Long-end supply the day before the Sep-16 FOMC — the auction that drew today's concession, reopened. Formal size/when-issued announcement is 2026-09-10, the same day as the 30Y reopening auction and the 10-20Y buyback operation and one day before CPI, which compresses the concession window into 09-10/09-11. Settles 09-18, quarterly OpEx day. An aggregator dating this sale to 09-17 was logged unresolved on 2026-08-29 and is refuted by the primary schedule above: 09-17 is the 10Y TIPS auction date. UPDATED 2026-09-08 by this event's own pulse check, from two Treasury primaries fetched direct. (1) ANTICIPATED SIZE $13B, and it has been in print since before this event's initial research: press release sb0590 (the 2026-08-05 quarterly refunding statement) publishes an anticipated-auction-size table whose Sep-26 row reads '69 58 70 44 39 13 22 28', i.e. 20-Year 13, and fiscaldata auctions_query confirms every 2026 reopening came at exactly $13B (01-21, 03-17, 04-22, 06-16, 07-22) against $16B for each new issue (02-18, 05-20, 08-19). UPDATED 2026-09-10 by this event's own pulse check: THE SIZE IS NOW PUBLISHED AND IS $13B. Treasury announced the reopening at 11:00 ET today and fiscaldata upcoming_auctions, fetched direct, carries 912810UX4 / Bond / 19-Year 11-Month / reopening Yes / offering_amt 13,000,000,000 / announcement 2026-09-10 / auction 2026-09-15 / issue 2026-09-18, matching sb0590 exactly and making 2026 reopenings six-for-six at $13B. Both the date and the size are now primary-sourced; the forward test on that number is owned by FT-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-09-03-1, which this event does not re-register. (2) THE 09-18 SETTLEMENT IS A CONVENTION, NOT A COINCIDENCE: press release sb0489 states that beginning with the 2026-06-16 reopening, 20-year bond reopenings settle on the Friday of the auction week (new issues still settle month-end), because 'shortening the when-issued period is expected to mitigate repo specialness that often occurs surrounding reopening auctions', made at the primary dealers' own request. So the overlap with quarterly OpEx is mechanical, and only two 20Y reopenings have ever run under this convention — which is why no pass of this ledger has found a published 20Y when-issued level.
